Review report

This review covers the cache loader and the worker loop.

Findings

1. Missing null check

load() returns null when the cache is empty. Callers do not check it.

func load() *Item {
    if len(cache) == 0 {
        return nil
    }
    return cache[0]
}

2. Slow loop

The loop in the worker is O(n^2). Use a map.

  • Build a map from key to item before iterating.
  • Replace the nested scan with one map lookup.

Summary

Done.
